tasks.goal: Patrol the perimeter path of Charter Hall, stopping at each charter display pillar for a status readout.
tasks.terrain: Compacted shell-rock service roads over reclaimed Merritt Island wetland; soft shoulders, standing water ruts after rain, alligator burrow holes at pad margins.
success: Visit all display pillars within +/- 0.5 m
safety_stops: E-stop if standing water depth sensor reads > 15 cm
Stop for any human within 2 m
Halt on roll/pitch exceeding 15 deg
Stop if wheel slip exceeds 20% for 3 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward confirms the patrol log and approves posting the charter status readout to the DAO record.

tasks.goal: Retrieve printed evidence summaries from the print station and deliver them to each researcher desk in the lab.
tasks.terrain: Flat raised lab flooring inside the Operations building; cable ramps, door thresholds, and server rack edges as ground obstacles.
success: Cycle time under 4 min per delivery
safety_stops: Stop arm if unexpected object enters workspace
E-stop on collision force > 10 N
Abort if gripper slip detected
Stop if a person crosses base path
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher signs off on delivery completion before evidence summaries are archived.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude sweep of the Proposal Forum to map attendee density before a debate session.
tasks.terrain: Indoor forum hall with high ceiling beams, hanging banners, and open doors to humid coastal air; crosswind gusts from Atlantic-side doors.
success: Coverage of >= 90% of forum floor area
Position hold within 10 cm at waypoints
safety_stops: Land immediately if battery < 20%
Land if a person is within 1.5 m below
Return-to-home on loss of positioning > 1 s
Land on propeller anomaly vibration threshold
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the density map before it is shared with Proposal Forum facilitators.

tasks.goal: Inspect conduit runs and cooling units along the Operations Deck walls and report thermal anomalies to the Task Router.
tasks.terrain: Raised grated decking with gaps, cable trays, and step-over conduits; humid salt-air corrosion patches on metal flooring near lagoon side.
success: Detect and localize >= 95% of seeded hotspot targets
Maintain stair/grating traversal with zero falls
Report anomalies within 30 s of detection
safety_stops: Sit down if foot slip detected on grating
Stop for humans within 2 m
Abort on body temperature or joint fault
Stop if grating gap > safe span detected ahead
tasks.human_in_loop: A facilities operator reviews flagged thermal anomalies before any maintenance task is routed.

tasks.goal: Greet visitors, present the current progress dashboard summary, and gesture toward the metrics wall.
tasks.terrain: Smooth observatory floor with display plinths and visitor queue barriers; occasional wet shoe tracks from marsh boardwalk entrance.
success: Speech intelligibility score >= 4/5 from visitor survey
Gesture accuracy to correct metrics panel 10/10
safety_stops: Sit and stop if tipped or pushed
Pause speech if a visitor is within 0.5 m of arms
Stop on joint overcurrent
Shutdown on battery < 15%
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the dashboard narration script updates each decision cycle.

tasks.goal: Survey the outdoor staging yard adjacent to Launch Complex 39A pad perimeter for debris and fence-line gaps.
tasks.terrain: Pad-adjacent crushed concrete and coquina fill with loose gravel, marsh grass encroachment, drainage culverts, and salty standing puddles between the pad and banana river lagoon side.
success: Detect 100% of seeded debris items >= 10 cm
Map 500 m fence line with <= 0.3 m gap-resolution
safety_stops: Stop and reverse if water depth > 10 cm
Stop for any wildlife or human within 3 m
Low-power sit if battery < 20%
E-stop on gravel slip detected over 3 consecutive steps
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves dispatching any follow-up maintenance task from the survey report.

tasks.goal: Demonstrate the contribution-model display by sorting charter tokens into the correct outcome bins on the exhibit table.
tasks.terrain: Fixed exhibit plinth indoors; table surface with felt liner, visitor hand intrusions at table edge as dynamic obstacles.
success: No contact force exceeding 5 N on intrusion
safety_stops: Stop arm instantly on contact detection
Reduce to gravity mode on visitor proximity
E-stop on self-collision prediction
Stop on torque limit breach
tasks.human_in_loop: An exhibit steward approves start of each public demo session and reviews any contact incidents.
